items.source: A component that will customize QuerydslBindings for the given entity path.
items.translation: 一个组件，用于为给定的实体路径自定义QuerydslBindings。

items.source: A component for QuerydslBindings customization acting as default customizer the given entity path regardless of the domain type.
items.translation: 一个用于自定义QuerydslBindings的组件，作为默认自定义器处理给定的实体路径，无论其领域类型如何。

items.source: QuerydslBindings allows definition of path specific bindings.
items.translation: QuerydslBindings 允许定义特定路径的绑定。
